name: duenudge
description: DueNudge — multi-tenant invoicing & payment-reminder SaaS for freelancers. Production reference build.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @duenudge/shared && npm run build -w @duenudge/api && npm run build -w @duenudge/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @duenudge/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @duenudge/api" "npm run dev -w @duenudge/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @duenudge/api
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v postgres && docker compose up -d postgres && sleep 3 && npm run migrate && npm run seed
